Product Details: The iBELL VORMIR VR BD21-45 Cordless Impact Drill is a 20V Max brushless drill machine designed for both professionals and DIY users. It delivers a maximum torque of 45Nm, runs on a high-efficiency Li-ion battery, and supports 2-speed settings for low and high torque tasks. Ideal for wood (32mm), steel (13mm), and concrete (13mm), this cordless power drill features a 13mm keyless chuck, impact drilling mode, and 20+3 torque control. A built-in LED work light helps in low-light areas, and its compact ergonomic body ensures control and comfort. The kit includes a 2.0Ah Li-ion battery, a fast 1-hour charger, and a sturdy BMC carry box, making it one of the best cordless drills in its category. It’s perfect for furniture assembly, construction, drilling walls, and garage work.
